critique: The exclamatory register and 'lad'/'young sir' address imitate Nox, but the lines over-explain plot logic ('I'm sure the two are in league', 'The soldiers will heal all the faster now those wretches can't touch it') and mix address forms within one speaker. The reminder's double period and the tidy wounded-barracks rationale feel assembled rather than written in Westwood's plainer voice.
